summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished_time capture logic in rich/progress.py, added the progress.elapsed default style, added Palette.__rich__ in rich/palette.py, added a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, and added tests (test_time_elapsed_column, the updated test_columns with hand-traced expected output, and tests/test_palette.py). Nothing was run, per the instructions, so all tests are unverified. The test_columns expected string was derived by hand-tracing the mock clock reads and checked against the old string's bar widths; it is the test most likely to need correction when run. Edits are uncommitted.
